title: Unreachable Match Arms (The Impossible Branch)
pattern: Writing match arms or conditional branches checking values that are mathematically or logically impossible due to preceding guard checks.
why_bad: Adds dead logical paths that can never be executed, increasing cognitive load and giving a false sense of comprehensive coverage.
detection: A match arm or conditional branch whose target value domain is completely excluded by preceding assertions, guards, or type constraints.
fix: Delete the unreachable match arm or redundant conditional check.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 17 ("Smells and Heuristics - G9: Dead Code"), p. 168.
